graphs: all 2-connected graphs on 4..6 vertices (geng -C); NA is closed under products, so 2-connected graphs suffice
measure: uniform (lambda = 1); exact integer arithmetic, Cov * Z^2 = Z N(U1 U2) - N(U1) N(U2)
events: all pairs of nontrivial up-sets U1 on S1 and U2 on S2 for disjoint edge sets with (|S1|,|S2|) = (3,3) or (4,2); an up-set may ignore coordinates, so smaller supports are covered
control: model K (uniform on edge sets containing a cycle, an up-set) on 4..5 vertices gives max Z^2 Cov = 2730 and 2186 (S1,S2) pairs admitting a positive covariance, so the scan detects positive association
